items.content: This transformation coordinates the division of night care between adults ONLY. It never diagnoses or treats postpartum depression, anxiety, or any medical condition; it never prescribes infant sleep-training, and it carries WHO/paediatric safe-sleep, vigilance and no-earplugs guardrails as non-negotiable boundary rules rather than as practice advice (any specific safe-sleep arrangement is deferred to the family's paediatrician or midwife); and it never replaces professional care. When exhaustion is more than tiredness, it stops and routes out to the verified shared crisis/escalation list.
